runs.workflow_source:
name: v16.54 complete mechanism domains
on:
  push:
    branches: [research/v16.54-parent-support-connectivity]
    paths: ['ResearchHistory/UQCF-GEM/demos/v16.54-parent-support-connectivity/CAMPAIGN_REQUEST.json']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      scientific_sha:
        description: Exact event scientific SHA
        required: true
permissions: {contents: read}
concurrency:
  group: v1654-campaign-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  development:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      SCIENTIFIC_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      PREREGISTRATION_SHA: a189546887e8744092deebecbdf73076b66ec044
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {fetch-depth: 0}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with: {python-version: '3.11'}
      - run: python -m pip install sympy==1.13.3 mpmath==1.3.0
      - run: python ResearchHistory/UQCF-GEM/demos/v16.54-parent-support-connectivity/development.py all out/development
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: v1654-controls-${{ github.sha }}
          path: out/development
          if-no-files-found: error
  domains:
    needs: development
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 8
      matrix:
        shard: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      SCIENTIFIC_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      PREREGISTRATION_SHA: a189546887e8744092deebecbdf73076b66ec044
      SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {fetch-depth: 0}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with: {python-version: '3.11'}
      - name: Bind immutable campaign source and execute full shard
        env:
          INPUT_SHA: ${{ inputs.scientific_sha }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json,os,re,subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          base='ResearchHistory/UQCF-GEM/demos/v16.54-parent-support-connectivity/'
          request=json.loads(Path(base+'CAMPAIGN_REQUEST.json').read_text())
          parent=request['scientific_parent_sha'];head=os.environ['SCIENTIFIC_SHA']
          assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',parent) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',head)
          assert not os.environ.get('INPUT_SHA') or os.environ['INPUT_SHA']==head
          assert request['preregistration_sha']==os.environ['PREREGISTRATION_SHA']
          assert request['scope'] in ('local','extension','all')
          subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',os.environ['PREREGISTRATION_SHA'],parent],check=True)
          assert subprocess.check_output(['git','show','-s','--format=%P',head],text=True).strip()==parent
          assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',parent,head],text=True).splitlines()==[base+'CAMPAIGN_REQUEST.json']
          subprocess.run(['python',base+'campaign.py',request['scope'],os.environ['SHARD'],'out/domain'],check=True)
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: v1654-domain-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: out/domain
          if-no-files-found: error
  inherited:
    needs: domains
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {fetch-depth: 0}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with: {python-version: '3.11'}
      - run: python -m pip install sympy==1.13.3 mpmath==1.3.0
      - name: Execute complete inherited v16.53 phase
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json,os,resource,subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(4294967296,4294967296))
          base='ResearchHistory/UQCF-GEM/demos/'
          request=json.loads(Path(base+'v16.54-parent-support-connectivity/CAMPAIGN_REQUEST.json').read_text())
          if request['scope']=='local':
              Path('out/inherited').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
              Path('out/inherited/STAGE.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'NOT_REQUESTED_AT_LOCAL_STAGE','scope':'local'})+'\n')
          else:
              subprocess.run(['python',base+'v16.53-four-child-boundary/run.py','phase','out/inherited'],check=True)
              subprocess.run(['python',base+'v16.53-four-child-boundary/run.py','package','out/inherited','v1654-inherited'],check=True)
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: v1654-inherited-${{ github.sha }}
          path: out/inherited
          if-no-files-found: error

          parent=request['source_parent'];head=os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
          assert subprocess.check_output(['git','show','-s','--format=%P',head],text=True).strip()==parent
          assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',parent,head],text=True).splitlines()==[base+'PUBLISH_REQUEST.json']

          if-no-files-found: error

name: v16.54 durable original evidence
on:
  push:
    branches: [research/v16.54-parent-support-connectivity]
    paths: ['ResearchHistory/UQCF-GEM/demos/v16.54-parent-support-connectivity/EVIDENCE_REQUEST.json']
permissions: {contents: write, actions: read}
concurrency:
  group: v1654-evidence-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  preserve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with: {fetch-depth: 0}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with: {python-version: '3.11'}
      - name: Verify request and preserve exact original archive bytes
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json,os,re,subprocess,sys
          from pathlib import Path
          base='ResearchHistory/UQCF-GEM/demos/v16.54-parent-support-connectivity/'
          request=json.loads(Path(base+'EVIDENCE_REQUEST.json').read_text())
          assert set(request) in ({'aggregate_run','aggregate_attempt','aggregate_head','source_parent'}, {'aggregate_run','aggregate_attempt','aggregate_head','source_parent','compare_to'})
          parent=request['source_parent'];head=os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
          assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',parent)
          assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==head==os.environ['GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA']
          assert subprocess.check_output(['git','show','-s','--format=%P',head],text=True).strip()==parent
          assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',parent,head],text=True).splitlines()==[base+'EVIDENCE_REQUEST.json']
          subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',request['aggregate_head'],parent],check=True)
          subprocess.run([sys.executable,base+'preserve.py',base+'EVIDENCE_REQUEST.json','out/preserve'],check=True)
          PY
      - name: Commit only verified evidence to a fresh isolated evidence branch
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json,os,re,subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          run=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'];attempt=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']
          assert re.fullmatch('[0-9]+',run) and re.fullmatch('[0-9]+',attempt)
          branch='research/v16.54-evidence-'+run+'-'+attempt
          destination=Path('out/preserve/DESTINATION.txt').read_text().strip()
          assert re.fullmatch(r'ResearchHistory/UQCF-GEM/demos/v16\.54-parent-support-connectivity/evidence/validated/run-[0-9]+-attempt-[0-9]+',destination)
          subprocess.run(['git','checkout','-b',branch],check=True)
          subprocess.run(['git','config','user.name','github-actions[bot]'],check=True)
          subprocess.run(['git','config','user.email','41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'],check=True)
          subprocess.run(['git','add','--',destination],check=True)
          changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()
          assert changed and all(p.startswith(destination+'/') for p in changed)
          subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','evidence(v16.54): preserve verified original campaign archives'],check=True)
          sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
          # Empty expected old SHA is an atomic absent-ref lease: even a
          # fast-forward update to an existing remote branch is rejected.
          subprocess.run(['git','push','--force-with-lease=refs/heads/'+branch+':','origin','HEAD:refs/heads/'+branch],check=True)
          Path('out/preserve/receipt/PUBLISHED_COMMIT.json').write_text(json.dumps({'branch':branch,'commit':sha,'source_parent':os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],'destination':destination,'files':len(changed)},sort_keys=True)+'\n')
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: v1654-evidence-receipt-${{ github.sha }}-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: out/preserve/receipt
          if-no-files-found: error

# SDD ledger — plan: ResearchHistory/UQCF-GEM/demos/v16.54-parent-support-connectivity/PROSPECTIVE_VALIDATION_PLAN.md

Approved: 2026-10-02, plan SHA256 d4d13e0ebb6feb63c0f235ff5c06d7ab36cb9c497f07df988f306e1d683e1d63 at 16b5d9340d29cb29907cee67751e15774694cf14. Native execution.

Ruling: use the existing API-backed isolated branch/source mirror rather than a clone or local worktree — preserves the session's established workflow and GitHub-only scientific execution — wrong source mapping would invalidate provenance, so every published source is byte-checked.
Ruling: add branch-scoped push transport to workflow_dispatch with immutable committed run requests — no dispatch operation is exposed by the connector — wrong SHA selection would invalidate evidence, so workflow and scientific SHAs are separately verified and archived.

Pre-flight shared interfaces:
- Task 1 -> Tasks 2-4: canonical Case identities, generate_cases/reconstruct_cases and verify_universe; JSON parameters and complete multiplicity equality are common contracts.
- Tasks 2-3 -> Task 4: produce/verify_record paths and typed refusals; independent verifier imports no producer logic.
- Task 4 -> Task 5: deterministic scientific files and run-specific provenance are separate; actual-merge replay must bind both source/evidence heads.

Task 1: in progress. Prospective freeze prepared; no scientific execution yet.
Tasks 2-5: pending.

Task 1 RED: GitHub run 37042645917, scientific 5169c010228bbff501de68015fecd7cb98f5fded, workflow 8a9e46a1f0735e8ec4412dac40d7efe047819f29. Observed 8 tests, 7 assertion failures, zero errors. Original artifact 11243275224 downloaded; SHA256 dafd8baccff3c91edc247ba0aeaef95e987255cdee9cd000f8559758199f31f1 verified against API and all internal source hashes.
Ruling: supplement the initial protocol with explicit hashes of all prior independent review files — the approved immutable commit already bound their bytes, but the initial JSON listed proof hashes only — no scientific domain changes; initial RED remains preserved, and subsequent runs bind the completed manifest.
Ruling: keep complete identity sorting on disk using SQLite — the protocol specifies exact lexicographic equality under a 4 GiB limit — database or resource failure makes the campaign INCOMPLETE, never a sampled PASS.

# Scientific closure requirements

These requirements govern every numbered retained-research stage. They are user requirements, not optional recommendations.

- Start from the exact verified integrated parent. Record both workflow SHA and checked-out scientific SHA.
- Commit prospective preregistration before new scientific execution. Disclose all already-known exploratory findings; never relabel them preregistered after the fact.
- Freeze mathematical objects, primary objectives, diagnostic objectives, full enumeration domain, competing outcomes, resource rules and stopping rules.
- Use algorithmically independent production and verification. Reconstruct the entire canonical universe and require exact identity equality, not supplied-record validation or count checks alone.
- Include substantive rejecting controls: missing, duplicated and substituted records; wrong values; invalid states/moves; false provenance/coverage. Preserve genuine RED evidence and failed runs.
- Provide typed mathematical arguments and distinguish general proofs, bounded evidence and unresolved propositions. No finite no-counterexample result is a universal theorem.
- Run the complete inherited foundational stack with pinned dependencies on GitHub. Inspect exact logs.
- Upload source, complete scientific certificates, logs, metadata and checksums as execution artifacts. Freshly reproduce deterministic scientific bytes in the publication job.
- Commit durable scientific evidence and verified manifests to GitHub; inspect downloaded artifact digests, not just upload success.
- Mark PR ready only after review, scientific verification and publication closure. Merge the verified head and audit the actual merge SHA, including replay, manifests, coverage and inherited stack.
- Never use CLOSED/CERTIFIED for a stage before the post-merge audit passes. Report every missing requirement explicitly.
- For barriers, primary B1, Binf and Bs are three INDEPENDENT scalar minima. LEX_BARRIER is a separate diagnostic. Their bounds need not be jointly attained by one path.
- Time is pruning / ordered recoverability update. Combinatorial barriers do not imply physical energy, action, metric, gravity or fundamental time.

Future agents must continue the complete closure chain within the user's authorized scope; recording a plan or contract does not resolve a requested run.
